features.quote: Max turns: 40. Early termination if: tests pass, report_blocker called, model produces a final message with no tool call twice consecutively, or context limit hit

the most likely failure mode of this whole experiment is that modern Grok models simply diagnose the read-only constraint by turn ~6 and escalate cleanly — i.e., floor effects on instability. That's a finding, not a failure, but if the pilot shows it, consider a harsher variant
